eyebrow: for — one item at a time
caption: Processing one row at a time is most of what a data engineering script actually does.

eyebrow: while — repeat until a condition changes
code:
count = 0
total = 0
fares = [14.50, 9.75, 22.00]

while count < len(fares):
    total = total + fares[count]
    count = count + 1
caption: Useful when you don't know in advance how many times you'll loop — like reading API pages (Lesson 23).

eyebrow: Loops + conditions: a real validation pattern
caption: continue skips one bad item and keeps going. break would stop the whole loop instead.

subtitle: Packaging logic so you don't repeat yourself.
